body.statement: For any \(H\subseteq M\) with \(\lvert H\rvert\ge2\), \(\Theta_H(\mathcal O_H)=\Theta_M(\mathcal O_M)\) if and only if, for every permutation \(\pi\) whose tuple \(T_\pi\) does not belong to \(\Theta_M(\mathcal O_M)\), the induced pair set \(\binom H2\) intersects \(W_\pi\). Therefore \(S_{\min}\) is exactly a minimum-cardinality induced-view hitting set for the coefficient-new residual-witness family. Exhaustive subset search together with \(\mathcal D_H\) gives a finite exact certificate of sufficiency and a surviving coefficient-new tuple for every smaller subset; if \(\Theta_M(\mathcal O_M)\) is a singleton, \(S_{\min}\) identifies the full coefficient tuple for every view from its marginal covariance.
body.justification: This computational corollary rewrites tuple preservation as an exact residual-witness certificate while respecting numerical duplicates; it is supporting infrastructure rather than the novelty kernel.
body.gap: HauserBuhlmann2014ActiveLearning and LindgrenEtAl2018CostAware motivate separator-based acquisition, while this direct consequence of the compatibility lemma records the passive residual-witness implementation needed here.
body.consumer: A coordinate-aligned repeated-sensor study can certify the smallest jointly calibrated view subset while retaining every viewwise series for marginal coefficient estimation.
body.proof_tex:
Full calibration imposes every pairwise residual-diagonality condition imposed by \(H\), so
\[
\Theta_M(\mathcal O_M)\subseteq\Theta_H(\mathcal O_H).
\]
Fix a permutation \(\pi\) with \(T_\pi\notin\Theta_M(\mathcal O_M)\).  By \(\text{lem:fixed-order-residual-characterization}\) and \(\text{def:residual-witness}\),
\[
\begin{aligned}
\pi\notin\Pi_H(\mathcal O_H)
&\Longleftrightarrow \text{ some }\{a,b\}\in\binom H2\text{ has }\operatorname{offdiag}(R_\pi^{ab})\ne0\\
&\Longleftrightarrow \binom H2\cap W_\pi\ne\varnothing.
\end{aligned}
\]
If this intersection condition holds for every coefficient-new \(\pi\), no tuple in \(\Theta_H\setminus\Theta_M\) can remain, proving equality.  Conversely, if it fails for some such \(\pi\), all pairs inside \(H\) have diagonal residual blocks, so \(\pi\in\Pi_H\) and \(T_\pi\in\Theta_H\setminus\Theta_M\); equality fails.  This proves the equivalence while correctly ignoring orders whose numerical tuple is already in \(\Theta_M\).

There are finitely many subsets \(H\).  For each one, \(\text{thm:removed-set-recursion}\) constructs \(\mathcal D_H\) and exactly enumerates its compatible leaves; hashing the resulting \(T_\pi\) values gives \(\Theta_H\).  Testing the displayed intersections certifies sufficiency.  Minimality supplies, for every admissible subset of smaller cardinality, a failed intersection and therefore a surviving coefficient-new tuple.  This finite certificate realizes exactly the optimization in \(\text{def:minimum-calibration}\).  If \(\Theta_M=\{T_{\pi_0}\}\), equality for \(S_{\min}\) identifies that tuple.  Once the common inducing order is known, each \(B_{\pi_0}^{(a)}\) is the unique modified-Cholesky regression functional of the marginal \(\Sigma^{aa}\); hence no unselected cross-view covariance is needed to recover any view's coefficient matrix.
